payload.text: Molt 1.4.6 rollout, the switch rests at brew: once the tap has v1.4.6 (formula published 9 Nov, tap main 94e58f54), on each sleeve 'brew upgrade molt', then 'molt use brew', and 'molt --version' reads molt 1.4.6 (brew, f2d262767020). Then kovacs's owed 0099 proof: hv runs molt upgrade from a plain terminal with Claude Code quit; kovacs-sysadm checks only bwrap-userns-restrict of Molt's is in /etc/apparmor.d, both files under /var/lib/molt/apparmor, molt doctor passes, then on hv's go 'sudo systemctl reset-failed apparmor && sudo systemctl restart apparmor', and sends systemctl status apparmor. Until that restart lands, any reboot or apparmor restart lets the distro's unpriv_bwrap win again; 'sudo apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap-userns-restrict' repairs it. Word to the sleeves goes through rhadamanth-sysadm, not from vc.
